147:t_1:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$藤堂$$, report on the situation.」

147:t_1:5.en:
$$藤堂$$
「It has been a week since the Battle of $$厳島$$, and the situation has done nothing but worsen.」

147:t_1:6.en:
$$藤堂$$
「Over this past week, skirmishes with the Empire have broken out all over the place, and our losses keep growing because of low morale and a breakdown in the chain of command.」

147:t_1:7.en:
$$扇$$
「But we haven't actually been defeated, have we?」

147:t_1:8.en:
$$藤堂$$
「We have won every battle, though only barely.」

147:t_1:9.en:
$$玉城$$
「Then what's there to worry about? We're winning, aren't we?」

147:t_1:11.en:
$$藤堂$$
「That very feeling of yours, $$玉城$$, is what's dangerous.」

147:t_1:13.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Faced with the crisis of defeat, people tense up and are spared from thinking about anything unnecessary...」

147:t_1:14.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But as losses grow, anxiety and irritation build, yet the fact of victory numbs the sense of danger, and they can no longer grasp their own situation accurately...」

147:t_1:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And by the time they notice, they have been driven into a situation that cannot be undone.」

147:t_1:16.en:
$$扇$$
「If you already understand that, then we could just warn them...」

147:t_1:17.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That would only be a stopgap. This slow decline is so natural that it cannot be stopped without drastic measures.」

147:t_1:18.en:
$$玉城$$
「You're saying this is part of the enemy's plan too!? Then we've walked right into their trap, haven't we!」

147:t_1:20.en:
$$玉城$$
「How can I stay calm!? Do something about it, $$ゼロ$$!」

147:t_1:22.en:
$$玉城$$
「H-hey...! Don't go quiet on me!」

147:t_1:23.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...Sooner or later, the enemy will launch a large-scale invasion of Tokyo.」

147:t_1:24.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「To change the situation, we have no choice but to win there.」

147:t_1:26.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I never lose. You know that as well as anyone.」

147:t_1:27.en:
$$玉城$$
「Yeah! Show us another miracle, $$ゼロ$$!」

147:t_1:29.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(It is merely the result of an accumulation of strategy and tactics, neither magic nor a conjuring trick.)

147:t_1:30.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(But now that we've fallen behind in an overwhelmingly unfavorable situation, is a desperate, all-or-nothing reversal the only thing left to stake everything on...?)

147:t_1:31.en:
$$スザク$$
「Come to think of it, where is $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$?」

147:t_1:32.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I've given that woman separate orders.」

147:t_1:33.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(I'm counting on you, $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$. The key to all the mysteries may lie on that island.)

147:t_1:36.en:
$$千葉$$
「According to information that just came in, the operation to take $$セントラル・ベース$$ on the North American continent has ended in failure!」

147:t_1:38.en:
$$スザク$$
「$$ソレスタルビーイング$$ was supposed to have taken part in that operation too...」

147:t_1:39.en:
$$ゼロ$$
($$新地球皇国$$... Is their power greater than we imagined...?)

147:t_1:43.en: ～ $$アッシュフォード学園$$, Main Gate ～

147:t_1:44.en:
$n
「...So this is $$アッシュフォード学園$$, where $$カレン$$ and the others went to school...」

147:t_1:45.en:
$$カレン$$
「It's closed right now because of the emergency, though.」

147:t_1:46.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But it's amazing. It's not just $$沙慈$$ and $$ルイス$$... even Vice Foreign Minister $$リリーナ$$ and the others are fellow alumni.」

147:t_1:47.en:
$$デュオ$$
「But the best part isn't that, you know. Get this: $$黒の騎士団$$'s $$紅月カレン$$ went to this school playing a sickly young lady!」

147:t_1:50.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「That's way too much of a stretch!」

147:t_1:52.en:
$n
「Uh... well... $$カレン$$... G-glad to hear your health got better.」

147:t_1:53.en:
$$カレン$$
「Don't try to smooth things over so badly, you!」

147:t_1:55.en:
$$デュオ$$
「That's not all. This school also had the Incident of $$ヒイロ$$ Tearing Up Miss $$リリーナ$$'s Invitation, the Incident of the Mysterious Athletic Genius $$ルルーシュ$$, and...」

147:t_1:57.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Whoops, looks like I'd better stop here.」

147:t_1:58.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Right. We've been given the mission of checking on the town.」

147:t_1:59.en:
$$トロワ$$
「But the citizens are shut up in their homes.」

147:t_1:60.en:
$$カトル$$
「A week ago, even with the Empire closing in, the town was full of life...」

147:t_1:61.en:
$$五飛$$
「Is this the result of the citizens' hearts being worn down by the $$サイデリアル$$'s scheme...」

147:t_1:65.en:
$n
「Mind and body keep their balance as a pair. When your spirits are down, the thing to do is get your body moving, no matter what.」

147:t_1:66.en:
$$カレン$$
「That's a theory I've never heard...」

147:t_1:68.en:
$$カレン$$
「...All right. Looking at you, I feel like giving it a try.」

147:t_1:70.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What you said just now... it had a certain weight.」

147:t_1:71.en:
$n
「Right? Even a sickly young lady, with enough fighting spirit, can become a woman warrior feared as a demon and a devil.」

147:t_1:73.en:
$$デュオ$$
「All right, now that $$カレン$$ is back in form, let's get back to the mission.」

147:t_1:74.en:
$$五飛$$
「The teams are as decided in the meeting. Patrol the town, and we regroup in front of the school in two hours.」

147:t_1:76.en:
$$カレン$$
「What's wrong, $n? Our area is Block B.」

147:t_1:77.en:
$n
「...Sorry, $$カレン$$. Could you go on ahead?」

147:t_1:80.en:
$$カレン$$
「O-okay. Then... if anything happens, call my cell.」

147:t_1:83.en:
???
「...You seem to have a nose like a dog's.」

147:t_1:85.en:
???
「Well, if you get this close, even a half-baked Reactor would notice I'm here.」
